content: Extend the host-independent W0112 cdev region-copy resolution contract with explicit backend memory retain/release callbacks, hold both resolved memory references through synchronous dispatch or asynchronous completion, and add regressions for reference lifetime and backpressure.

Implemented resolver-owned destination/source memory reference callbacks in a536dd0, documented the contract, and verified focused cdev/client/component tests 3/3 plus full development CTest 84/84; git diff --check passed.
